rca_inverse_correlation: The morning brief predicted a 'Bearish' IHSG signal, but the market closed 'Bullish' (+0.46%), primarily driven by unexpected foreign accumulation (Net Buy Rp 829,70 Miliar) and strong performance in key sectors like Health Care and Technology.
The morning brief predicted 'Foreign Flow: Distribution', but the actual foreign flow was 'Accumulation' (Net Buy Rp 829,70 Miliar), which directly contributed to the bullish market close.
lessons: Ketika IHSG diprediksi Bearish dengan confidence 67% dan foreign flow diprediksi Distribution, tetapi foreign flow aktual adalah Accumulation (Net Buy Rp 829,70 Miliar) dan IHSG ditutup Bullish (+0.46%), maka sentimen pasar dapat berbalik arah secara signifikan.

Ketika sektor Kesehatan diprediksi Bearish, tetapi sektor tersebut mengalami kenaikan terbesar (+17K), maka analisis sektor perlu mempertimbangkan faktor-faktor pendorong spesifik yang mungkin tidak tercakup dalam prediksi awal.

Ketika Rupiah diprediksi stabil oleh BI, tetapi ada komitmen spesifik dari Bank Indonesia untuk meningkatkan aliran masuk investasi portofolio asing, maka Rupiah dapat menguat (-0.318%) dan mendukung sentimen positif pasar.
summary: The morning brief's bearish IHSG and foreign flow distribution predictions were incorrect, as the market closed bullish (+0.46%) driven by unexpected foreign accumulation (Net Buy Rp 829,70 Miliar) and strong performance in sectors like Health Care and Technology.
